page_title: NAN 0-1 LEN | Nantes v Lens 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90+2' Kader Bamba (Nantes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Wesley Said (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Florent Batta interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
89' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
86' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) replaces Andy Diouf.
86' Substitution. Jhoanner Chavez makes his way off the pitch and Massadio Haidara (Lens) comes on as his replacement.
84' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) picks up a long through ball, but Brice Samba deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
82' Kevin Danso (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' It's a free kick to Nantes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
81' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
81' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) meets a cross inside the box, but Brice Samba wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
80' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
79' That will be all from Elye Wahi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Wesley Said (Lens).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that David Costa can be given a rest.
78' Here is a change. Florent Mollet is going off and Jocelyn Gourvennec gives the last tactical orders to Stredair Appuah (Nantes).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matthis Abline (Nantes) comes onto the pitch for Tino Kadewere.
77' Kader Bamba (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' David Costa (Lens) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
75' Florent Mollet (Nantes) stands over the ball and it looks like he will have a direct shot at goal as the free kick is in a very promising position.
74' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
73' Nantes keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
71' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.

70' Lens slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
68' Elye Wahi (Lens) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Florian Sotoca. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
66' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
64' Now Lens have a corner.
64' That's an easy save for Alban Lafont, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from David Costa (Lens).
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Douglas Augusto (Nantes) was quite harsh and Florent Batta didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

60' David Costa (Lens) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
59' Moussa Sissoko is being substituted because of an injury. Jocelyn Gourvennec sends Kader Bamba (Nantes) on the pitch.
58' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) sends a long ball in, but Brice Samba comfortably gathers the ball.
56' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 3:0.
55' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
52' A clumsy foul by Nathan Zeze (Nantes) and Florent Batta blows his whistle.
50' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
48' 0 - 1 David Costa (Lens) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
46' The whistle blows and Florent Batta starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nantes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save.
41' Florent Mollet (Nantes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
40' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) is caught offside!

39' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
38' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
37' One of the Nantes players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
34' Great save! Tino Kadewere (Nantes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Brice Samba.
33' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
33' Total attempts – 0:7.
30' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
27' What was Tino Kadewere (Nantes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
25' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florent Batta no option but to blow his whistle.
21' The goal by Nantes is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
21' The Nantes players joy may have been justified, because referee Florent Batta is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
21' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nantes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Foul! Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
15' A long-range free kick from about 26 metres out. David Costa (Lens) takes it, but his effort is saved.
13' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Florent Batta signals a foul. Lens have been awarded a free kick.
12' The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
12' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Kelvin Amian (Nantes) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Pallois.
10' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Florian Sotoca (Lens) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Alban Lafont makes a comfortable save.
4' The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Costa (Lens).
2' David Costa (Lens) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Florent Batta.
